dedupe_keys.name: two kazakhstan coal fired combined heat and power operating cases

description: This deposit provides operating and technical inputs for two coal-fired combined heat and power plants in Karaganda and Pavlodar, Kazakhstan. The research collaborators assembled boiler and turbine characteristics, steam parameters, electricity and heat demand, ambient-temperature relationships and economic assumptions for joint production and maintenance scheduling. The cases represent plants installed during 1970–1990; those installation years do not establish the dates of every input observation. Mendeley Data lists one Excel XLS workbook in the current version 3, freely available under CC BY 4.0. The article cites version 2, which was also opened. Plant-specific configurations and an unspecified common observation interval limit transfer to other heat networks or current operating costs. A reviewer-assessed use is testing unit-commitment and maintenance-scheduling simulations. model-pypsa is a related energy-system optimization tool, although workbook import and representation of steam constraints were not tested. This two-plant workbook is distinct from the earlier G2 national spatial electricity-market lead.
